arabic text:
Haq maangne darbar me bulwaya gaya hai,
yeh ajr e risalat tumhe ummat ne diya hai
Tum royi to hanste rahe kya zulm kiya hai,
hai surkh isi gham me huwa gumbade
khizra
english translation text:
You were summoned to the court to demand
your right; this was the reward the nation
gave you for the Prophet's mission. When you
wept, they continued to laugh—what oppression! Through this
grief, even the green dome turned red.

arabic text:
Kya zulm o sitam tum pe tha makhdooma e
alam, din shab me badal jaye agar sehle
tera gham
Kyun kar na azadar kare noha o matam,
kam hai jo kare hashr talak girya o pursa.
english translation text:
What oppression and cruelty you endured, O Lady of
the worlds; if your grief were made easy, day
itself would turn into night. How could the mourners
not recite laments and perform matam? Even weeping
and condolences until Judgement Day would be too little.

arabic text:
Sadqa jo tere dar ka sada khaate rahe hai, jo
tere ghulamo ki ghulami me pale hai
Ab murda zameeri ki mujisme yeh bane
hai, be zarf bhula bhaite hai ehsaan Khadija
english translation text:
Those who always lived upon the charity of your door,
and were raised in servitude to your servants,
now became embodiments of dead conscience;
the unworthy forgot the favour of Khadija.

arabic text: alam ke liye aaya nabi banke jo rehmat,\nkunbe pe usi ke hi huwi kaisi qayamat
english translation text: He who came as a mercy to all creation—\nwhat a Judgement Day descended upon his household.

arabic text: Mohsin ki shahadat ka sabab bangayi\nummat, jo hurmat e kaba tha usi dark o\njalaaya
english translation text: The nation became the cause of\nMohsin's martyrdom; they burned the very\ndoor whose sanctity equalled the Kaaba.

arabic text:
tehreer e nabi phar ke is tarha sataya,
Hasnain ko jhutladiya aur tumko rulaaya
Uspe bhi jafa karte huwe khowf na khaya,
kehte ho jis khud bhi nabi umme abeeha
english translation text:
They tore the Prophet's written instruction and tormented you;
they denied Hasan and Hussain and made you weep.
Even then they felt no fear while committing cruelty,
though the Prophet himself called you Umm-e-Abiha.

arabic text:
Kio farsh e ghum e fatima zehra na
bichaein, Jab khak urati thi har ek simt
hawaein
Thi noha kuna'n shehr e madina ki fizaein,
Jalta hua dar apkay pehlo pe giraya
english translation text:
Why should we not spread the mourning
floor for Fatima Zahra, when the
winds scattered dust in every direction? The
atmosphere of Madina itself recited lament;
the burning door fell upon your side.

arabic text:
'Salman' likhun kaise qayamat ka who
manzar
haq maangne darbaar gayeen binte
payambar
Bad bakht shaqi bheta raha takht ke upar
parhte the malaik bhi sar e arsh yeh noha
english translation text:
O "Salman", how can I write that
scene of Judgement Day? The Prophet's daughter
went to the court to demand
her right. The wretched tyrant remained seated
upon the throne, while the angels
upon the Divine Throne recited this lament.
